protocol.warning: Exploratory model selection on the same CV; not an unbiased final generalization estimate.
protocol.normalization: All learned scaling and feature selection fitted only on training subjects. No held-out-subject/session statistics or future samples used.

amplitude_bias.per_subject_robust_normalization: Not evaluated for official target: unseen subjects have no training-fold subject statistics; full-session normalization would use future/test data.
amplitude_bias.session_limitation: One recording per subject; subject and session effects cannot be separated.

conclusion: No evidence that 0.9 AUC/bACC is achievable under unseen-subject, causal 6-second constraints with these candidates. Repeated CV tuning is optimistic; no official-model replacement made.
